title: Equilibrium Technique Mapping
description: Canonical record that joins one Microsoft Kubernetes Threat Matrix technique to its MITRE ATT&CK technique, MITRE Detection Strategies, MITRE Data Components, and normalized vendor detection logic. Data Components are first-class objects and are the primary anchor for all detection authoring.

Confidence.description: Author's confidence that the detection logic, when run against the required telemetry, will fire on the modeled adversary behavior with acceptable signal-to-noise.

DataComponent.description: First-class MITRE ATT&CK Data Component. The detection contract is anchored here: every vendor detection must declare which Data Components it satisfies.

id.description: MITRE Data Component identifier (e.g., DC0064). Use null when MITRE has not assigned one.

data_source_id.description: MITRE Data Source identifier the component belongs to (e.g., DS0017).

definition.description: Authoritative definition copied or paraphrased from MITRE.

relevant_events.description: Concrete events or fields a defender would actually observe (e.g., 'Kubernetes audit event verb=create on /pods/*/exec').

MitreCrossReference.description: A secondary MITRE ATT&CK technique that this record relates to but is not the primary mapping. Use for: cases where community detection content (Sigma, Falco, EDR) tags a different MITRE ID than the canonical one; cases where a more-specific sub-technique exists; cases where the technique enables a downstream technique. Each entry must cite the source(s) that establish the relationship.

relationship.description: How this cross-referenced technique relates to the primary MITRE technique.

rationale.description: Plain-language explanation of why this cross-reference is meaningful for defenders. Should be specific, not generic.

sources.description: URLs that establish the relationship: the Sigma rule, the Falco rule, the MITRE sub-technique page, etc.

DetectionStrategy.description: MITRE ATT&CK Detection Strategy or analytic referenced by this technique.

data_component_refs.description: Names of Data Components (as they appear in this record) that this strategy depends on.

id.description: Microsoft does not consistently publish stable IDs; use null when absent.

VendorDetection.description: Normalized detection block. Same intent across vendors, different syntax. Every block names the Data Components it satisfies so the matrix can flag coverage gaps.

intent.description: Vendor-agnostic statement of what the query is trying to catch. Should read identically in spirit across vendor blocks.

query.description: The actual query, rule, or API payload. Multiline strings are preserved verbatim.

required_telemetry.description: Vendor-specific telemetry channels that must be enabled (e.g., 'Wiz Kubernetes audit log connector', 'Falco syscall driver', 'Sysdig agent with K8s audit hook').

mapped_data_components.description: Names of Data Components (declared in this record's data_components[]) that this detection actually satisfies.

id.description: Equilibrium record ID. Two legal forms: 'EQ-T<id>' for records anchored on a unique MITRE technique (e.g., EQ-T1609), and 'EQ-MS-TA<id>' for records anchored on a Microsoft K8s Threat Matrix technique (used when multiple MS techniques map to one MITRE technique, or when the MS technique has no MITRE mapping).

mitre_attack.description: MITRE ATT&CK mapping. Null when the Microsoft K8s technique has no MITRE counterpart (4 such cases in the matrix as of 2026-05-04: Collecting Data from Pod, Kubeconfig file, SSH server running inside container, Static Pods).

mitre_cross_references.description: Secondary MITRE technique mappings that defenders should know about. Optional. See $defs/MitreCrossReference for the relationship taxonomy.

data_components.description: Primary anchor when populated: every vendor detection must reference at least one entry here by name. Empty array is permitted on stub records that have not yet been researched; CI's data-component cross-reference check will block any vendor_detection that references a name not in this array.
